deterministic Sinatra API for D&D 5e DM helpers: dice, character math,\ncombat state, compendium, campaign management, play-by-post campaigns, and\nencounter mechanics. There are no background jobs, no external services, and a\nsingle SQLite database file.\n\n## Runtime versions\n\nThe Gemfile pins the runtime/framework versions used by this workspace:\n\n- Ruby 4.0.5\n- Sinatra 4.2.1\n- Rack 3.2.6\n- Rackup 2.3.1\n- Puma 8.0.2\n- sqlite3 2.9.5\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nbundle install\nPORT=4567 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` starts the server in the foreground on `127.0.0.1`, using the `PORT`\nenvironment variable. It also removes and recreates `game.db` on every launch so\neach run begins with a fresh schema.\n\nVerify the server is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n```\n\nExpected response:\n\n```json\n{ \"ok\": true }\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C`.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n```\napp.rb                    # Sinatra setup, shared helpers, route requires\nlib/\n  auth.rb                 # Bearer-token authentication and password hashing\n  game_logic.rb           # Pure D&D 5e calculations and encounter constants\n  storage.rb              # SQLite persistence layer\n  validation.rb           # Input validation helpers\n  routes/                 # Domain route files (loaded in precedence order)\n    core.rb               # Health, dice, checks, initiative, encounter XP\n    characters.rb         # Ability modifier, proficiency, derived stats\n    combat_sessions.rb    # Combat session state and conditions\n    auth.rb               # User registration and login\n    storage.rb            # Storage status and reset\n    compendium.rb         # Monster and item compendium\n    campaigns.rb          # Campaigns, quests, factions/NPCs, inventory\n    phb.rb                # PHB rule helpers (spell slots, rests, load)\n    dm_tools.rb           # DM encounter builder, loot, session recap\n    downtime.rb           # Crafting projects\n    sessions.rb           # Session scheduling, attendance, audit, analytics\n    play_lobby.rb         # Play campaign creation, membership, start\n    play_turns.rb         # Narrations, actions, resolutions, turn views\n    play_document.rb      # Campaign story / dm_notes document\n    play_scenes.rb        # Scene state\n    play_locations.rb     # Location graph\n    play_travel_rest.rb   # Travel and rest turns\n    play_encounters.rb    # Encounters, roster, combat turns, actions, rewards\n    play_characters.rb    # Character damage, death saves, build, level-up\nrun.sh                    # Foreground server launcher\nGemfile                   # Version pins\n```\n\n`app.rb` requires the four helper modules, configures the server bind address\nand port, initializes the SQLite schema, registers the helper modules, defines\nshared request helpers, and then loads the route files.\n\nThe app uses **classic Sinatra** style (`require 'sinatra'` and routes defined at\nthe top level), so `bundle exec ruby app.rb` works directly.\n\n## State, persistence, and request-routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db` (SQLite). The `Storage` module owns every\nSQL statement and the single shared database connection.\n\n- `Storage::DB_PATH` resolves to the project-root `game.db`.\n- `Storage::DB_MUTEX` serializes all database access because Puma may serve\n  requests concurrently and the Ruby `sqlite3` connection object is not\n  thread-safe for unsynchronized use.\n- `Storage::SCHEMA_VERSION` is `1`. It is recorded in the `schema_info` table on\n  first boot.\n- JSON is stored as text columns (`*_json`) and parsed/serialized by the\n  storage layer. `Storage.json_column(row, column, default)` centralizes the\n  parse step; `Storage.ensure_column!(db, table, column, definition)` runs the\n  incremental schema migrations so older databases can be reopened safely.\n\nSchema is created on boot by `Storage.init_schema!`. Tables are created with\n`IF NOT EXISTS`, so restarts are safe. The `POST /v1/storage/reset` endpoint\n(and `Storage.reset!`) drops and recreates all tables for tests.\n\nKey tables:\n\n- `combat_sessions` — turn order, active round/turn, and per-target conditions.\n- `users` — username, password hash, role (`dm` or `player`).\n- `compendium_monsters` / `compendium_items` — stat blocks and magic items.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events` — base campaigns.\n- `campaign_quests` — quest headers, milestones, completed milestones.\n- `campaign_factions` / `campaign_npcs` — factions and their NPCs.\n- `campaign_inventory` — party and per-character item quantities.\n- `campaign_crafting_projects` — downtime crafting state.\n- `campaign_sessions` / `campaign_session_attendance` — scheduled sessions and\n  attendance.\n- `play_campaigns`, `play_campaign_members`, `play_campaign_narrations` —\n  owned live-play campaigns, party membership, and ordered narration/action/\n  resolution events. `play_campaigns` stores the durable campaign document\n  (`story`, `dm_notes`), turn queue, turn number, scene/location state, and\n  pre-combat exploration state.\n- `play_campaign_scenes` / `play_campaign_locations` /\n  `play_campaign_location_connections` — scene and location graph.\n- `play_campaign_encounters` / `play_campaign_encounter_monsters` — active\n  encounters, monster roster, bound party combatants, conditions, readies,\n  rewards, and cached initiative order.\n\n### Routing\n\nRoutes are grouped by domain in `lib/routes/`. Each file contains only Sinatra\nroute definitions and delegates persistence and math to `Storage` and\n`GameLogic`. Files are loaded from `app.rb` in precedence order, so route\nmatching order matches the original monolithic layout.\n\nEvery successful JSON route calls `content_type :json` before producing the\nbody. Error halts use `json_error(status, message)`, which sets the\n`application/json` content type and a JSON body `{\"error\":\"...\"}`. The\n`POST /v1/dice/stats` route intentionally omits the explicit content type on\nits validation halt, preserving original behavior.\n\n### Helper modules\n\n- `GameLogic` — pure functions (ability modifier, proficiency, initiative order,\n  encounter XP/difficulty). No side effects; easy to test in isolation.\n- `Validation` — input guards that may `halt` with a 400 response. They depend on\n  the request context through the `json_error` helper.\n- `Auth` — bearer-token extraction, password hashing, and role enforcement.\n  Uses PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with a username-derived salt.\n\nShared application helpers live in the anonymous `helpers` block in `app.rb`:\n\n- `parse_json_body` — read and parse JSON; Put the route in the most specific `lib/routes/*.rb` file (or create a new\n   domain file and require it from `app.rb` in the right precedence order).\n2. If the endpoint is pure math, add the calculation to `lib/game_logic.rb`.\n3. If it validates input, add a validation helper to `lib/validation.rb` or\n   reuse an existing one. Keep validation rules identical to prior stages\n   because the evaluator suite is cumulative.\n4. If it persists data, add the SQL methods to `lib/storage.rb`. Reuse\n   `Storage.json_column` for JSON columns and `Storage.with_db` for all access.\n5. Keep responses deterministic. Do not add randomness or time-dependent\n   behavior.\n6. Do not remove or rename existing endpoints, status codes, or response keys\n   unless the stage spec explicitly changes.\n7. For play-campaign routes that need both id validation and authentication,\n   call `validate_campaign_id!(campaign_id)` before the auth helper so that an\n   empty id still produces a 400 response before a 401/403.\n\n### Testing\n\nThere is no bundled test framework. Useful local checks:\n\n- Syntax: `ruby -c app.rb && ruby -c lib/*.rb && ruby -c lib/routes/*.rb`\n- Load check: `bundle exec ruby -e \"require_relative 'app'; puts 'loaded'\"`\n- Route list: `bundle exec ruby -e \"require_relative 'app'; puts Sinatra::Application.routes.keys\"`\n- Manual endpoint check with the server running: `curl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health`\n\nWhen testing against the database, keep in mind that `POST /v1/storage/reset`\nwill destroy all data. `run.sh` already starts with a fresh `game.db`, so a\nsingle server run is isolated.\n\n### Important invariants\n\n- The `combat_order` tie-breaker is total score → Dexterity score → name, so\n  order is deterministic.\n- The encounter multiplier table follows the D&D 5e DMG: 1×, 1.5×, 2×, 2.5×,\n  3×, 4× for monster counts 1, 2, 3–6, 7–10, 11–14, 15+.\n- Only level 3 party thresholds are currently populated in\n  `GameLogic::LEVEL_THRESHOLDS` because the existing endpoint suite exercises\n  level 3 parties.\n- The password salt is deterministic (`\"dnd-auth-salt-#{username}\"`). AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n        )\n        if existing\n          new_quantity = existing['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.assign_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, quantity)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        party_row = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n        return false unless party_row && party_row['quantity'] >= quantity\n\n        new_party_quantity = party_row['quantity'] - quantity\n        if new_party_quantity.positive?\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_party_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'DELETE FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        end\n\n        existing_char = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n        )\n        if existing_char\n          new_char_quantity = existing_char['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_char_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.inventory_summary(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      party_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner = ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      assigned_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner != ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions = db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'healing-potion', 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions_available = healing_potions ? healing_potions['quantity'] : 0\n\n      {\n        party_items: party_items,\n        assigned_items: assigned_items,\n        healing_potions_available: healing_potions_available\n      }\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Campaign sessions ---\n\n  def self.campaign_session_exists?(campaign_id, id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_sessions WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id])\n        return nil unless row\n\n        new_completed = [row['days_completed'] + days, row['days_required']].min\n        status = new_completed >= row['days_required'] ? 'complete' : 'active'\n\n        db.execute(\n          'UPDATE campaign_crafting_projects SET days_completed = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n          [new_completed, status, campaign_id, id]\n        )\n\n        if status == 'complete'\n          existing = db.get_first_row(\n            'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party']\n          )\n          if existing\n            db.execute(\n              'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n        )\n        if existing\n          new_quantity = existing['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.assign_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, quantity)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        party_row = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n        return false unless party_row && party_row['quantity'] >= quantity\n\n        new_party_quantity = party_row['quantity'] - quantity\n        if new_party_quantity.positive?\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_party_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'DELETE FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        end\n\n        existing_char = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n        )\n        if existing_char\n          new_char_quantity = existing_char['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_char_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.inventory_summary(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      party_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'healing-potion', 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions_available = healing_potions ? healing_potions['quantity'] : 0\n\n      {\n        party_items: party_items,\n        assigned_items: assigned_items,\n        healing_potions_available: healing_potions_available\n      }\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Campaign sessions ---\n\n  def self.campaign_session_exists?(campaign_id, id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_sessions WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_id = ?',\n            [new_quantity, campaign_id, character_id, item_id]\n          )\n          new_quantity\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO play_campaign_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity]\n          )\n          quantity\n        end\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Removes the requested quantity from a character's stack. Returns the new\n  # total quantity on success, or nil when the stack does not exist or the\n  # requested quantity exceeds the held amount.\n  def self.remove_character_inventory_item(campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        row = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?',\n          [campaign_id, character_id, item_id]\n        )\n        return nil unless row\n\n        held = row['quantity'].to_i\n        return nil if quantity > held\n\n        new_quantity = held - quantity\n        if new_quantity.positive?\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE play_campaign_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?',\n            [new_quantity, campaign_id, character_id, item_id]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'DELETE FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?',\n            [campaign_id, character_id, item_id]\n          )\n        end\n        new_quantity\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Consumes one unit of +item_id+ from the character's inventory and applies\n  # its effect. Returns a hash with the remaining quantity and healing amount,\n  # or nil when the item is not held or the stack is empty.\n  def self.consume_character_inventory_item(campaign_id, character_id, item_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        row = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?',\n          [campaign_id, character_id, item_id]\n        )\n        return nil unless row\n\n        held = row['quantity'].to_i\n        return nil if held <= 0\n\n        new_quantity = held - 1\n        if new_quantity.positive?\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE play_campaign_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?',\n            [new_quantity, campaign_id, character_id, item_id]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'DELETE FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?',\n            [campaign_id, character_id, item_id]\n          )\n        end\n\n        hp_restored = 0\n        if item_id == 'healing-potion'\n          hp_restored = 5\n          char_row = db.get_first_row(\n            'SELECT hp_current, hp_max, status FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n            [campaign_id, character_id]\n          )\n          if char_row\n            current_hp = char_row['hp_current'].to_i\n            max_hp = char_row['hp_max'].to_i\n            new_hp = [current_hp + hp_restored, max_hp].min\n            new_status = if new_hp > 0\n                           'conscious'\n                         elsif %w[stable dead].include?(char_row['status'])\n                           char_row['status']\n                         else\n                           'unconscious'\n                         end\n            db.execute(\n              'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n              [new_hp, new_status, campaign_id, character_id]\n            )\n          end\n        end\n\n        { quantity: new_quantity, hp_restored: hp_restored }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Character equipment and attunement ---\n\n  def self.load_character_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, slot)\n    row = with_db do |db|\n      db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT item_id, attuned FROM play_campaign_character_equipment WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND slot = ?',\n        [campaign_id, character_id, slot]\n      )\n    end\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      item_id: row['item_id'],\n      attuned: row['attuned'] == 1\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.save_character_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, slot, item_id, attuned)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO play_campaign_character_equipment (campaign_id, character_id, slot, item_id, attuned) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, character_id, slot, item_id, attuned ? 1 : 0]\n      )\n    end\n    { item_id: item_id, attuned: attuned }\n  end\n\n  def self.character_attuned_equipment_exists?(campaign_id, character_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_character_equipment WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND attuned = 1',\n        [campaign_id, character_id]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.increment_nudge_count(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute('UPDATE play_campaigns SET nudge_count = nudge_count + 1 WHERE id = ?', [campaign_id])\n      db.get_first_value('SELECT nudge_count FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [campaign_id])\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaign narrations ---\n\n  # Inserts a single narration/action/resolution event and returns its\n  # sequence number. Sequence numbers are per-campaign and monotonically\n  # increasing so the log order matches insertion order.\n  def self.insert_narration(campaign_id, kind, actor, type, text, target = nil)\n    with_db do |db|\n      sequence = (db.get_first_value('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) FROM play_campaign_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?', [campaign_id]) || 0).to_i + 1\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, type, target, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, type, target, text]\n      )\n      sequence\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_narration(campaign_id, actor, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'narration', actor, nil, text, nil)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_action(campaign_id, actor, type, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'action', actor, type, text, nil)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_resolution(campaign_id, actor, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'resolution', actor, nil, text, nil)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_combat_action(campaign_id, actor, type, target, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'combat_action', actor, type, text, target)\n  end\n\n  def self.play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'SELECT sequence, kind, actor, type, target, text FROM play_campaign_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY sequence ASC',\n        [campaign_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        result = { sequence: row['sequence'], kind: row['kind'], actor: row['actor'] }\n        result[:type] = row['type'] if row['type']\n        result[:target] = row['target'] if row['target']\n        result[:text] = row['text']\n        result\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaign turn advancement ---\n\n  def self.update_play_campaign_turn(campaign_id, current_actor, phase, turn_number)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, phase = ?, turn_number = ? AND c.from_id = ?\n          ORDER BY c.to_id\n        SQL\n        [campaign_id, from_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        { id: row['to_id'], name: row['name'], travel_turns: row['travel_turns'] }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.load_connection(campaign_id, from_id, to_id)\n    row = with_db do |db|\n      db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT travel_turns FROM play_campaign_location_connections WHERE campaign_id = ? AND to_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, from_id, to_id]\n      )\n    end\n    return nil unless row\n\n    { from_id: from_id, to_id: to_id, travel_turns: row['travel_turns'] }\n  end\n\n  def self.create_nudge(campaign_id, actor, message)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'nudge', actor, nil, message, nil)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_scene_event(campaign_id, actor, scene_id)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'scene', actor, nil, scene_id, nil)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_travel(campaign_id, actor, destination_id)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'travel', actor, nil, destination_id, nil)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_rest(campaign_id, actor, rest_type)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'rest', actor, rest_type, rest_type, nil)\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaign encounters ---\n\n  def self.encounter_exists?(campaign_id, id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n        [JSON.dump(conditions), campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n      conditions[target]\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaign encounter party combatants ---\n\n  def self.add_encounter_combatant(campaign_id, encounter_id, member, character_id, name, initiative)\n    with_db do |db|\n      row = db.get_first_row('SELECT combatants_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, encounter_id])\n      return nil unless row\n\n      combatants = json_column(row, 'combatants_json', [])\n      return nil if combatants.any? { |c| c[:member] == member || c['member'] == member }\n\n      combatants << { member: member, character_id: character_id, name: name, initiative: initiative }\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET combatants_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n        [JSON.dump(combatants), campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n      combatants.last\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.remove_encounter_combatant(campaign_id, encounter_id, member)\n    with_db do |db|\n      row = db.get_first_row('SELECT combatants_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, encounter_id])\n      return false unless row\n\n      combatants = json_column(row, 'combatants_json', [])\n      before = combatants.length\n      combatants.reject! { |c| c[:member] == member || c['member'] == member }\n      return false if combatants.length == before\n\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET combatants_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n        [JSON.dump(combatants), campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Persists the computed initiative order for an encounter.\n  def self.save_encounter_order(campaign_id, encounter_id, order)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET order_json = ? Returns nil when no order has been stored.\n  def self.load_encounter_order(campaign_id, encounter_id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, encounter_id]) }\n    return nil unless row && row['order_json']\n\n    parsed = JSON.parse(row['order_json'])\n    return nil unless parsed.is_a?(Array)\n\n    parsed.map { |h| h.transform_keys(&:to_sym) }\n  rescue JSON::ParserError\n    nil\n  end\n\n  # Records a ready-action trigger for the current encounter.\n  def self.add_encounter_ready(campaign_id, encounter_id, actor, trigger)\n    with_db do |db|\n      row = db.get_first_row('SELECT readies_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? JSON.parse(row['readies_json']) : []\n      record = { actor: actor, trigger: trigger }\n      readies << record\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET readies_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? Targets are resolved in this order:\n  # an encounter monster by monster_id, then a bound party combatant by member\n  # username. HP floors at 0. Returns a result hash or nil if the target is\n  # not found or not a bound combatant.\n  def self.apply_damage_to_encounter_target(campaign_id, encounter_id, target, amount)\n    with_db do |db|\n      monster_row = db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT hp_max, hp_current FROM play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? AND monster_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, encounter_id, target]\n      )\n      if monster_row\n        hp_before = monster_row['hp_current'].to_i\n        hp_after = [hp_before - amount, 0].max\n        db.execute(\n          'UPDATE play_campaign_encounter_monsters SET hp_current = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? AND monster_id = ?',\n          [hp_after, campaign_id, encounter_id, target]\n        )\n        return {\n          target: target,\n          hp_before: hp_before,\n          hp_after: hp_after,\n          damage: hp_before - hp_after\n        }\n      end\n\n      member_row = db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT hp_max, hp_current FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, target]\n      )\n      if member_row\n        enc_row = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT combatants_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ?
